notes:
**A media library, a model picker, and workflows you can read.** Keen 0.35.0 gives the files on your server a home, lets you choose which model answers chat and which runs your workflows, and adds Work Prep: one command that briefs you on a task before you start it.

## Work Prep

- **Brief me on this task.** Open a task, press ⌘K and choose Work Prep. A fresh floating chat, pinned to that task, sums up where it stands, what blocks it, the knowledge linked to it and what you discussed about it before, then suggests a first step.
- **The assistant can look back.** Ask "what have we talked about on this task?" and chat finds the earlier conversations.

## Choose your models

- **Settings › AI Assistant › Models** has one row for chat and one for workflows. Chat uses the Anthropic models in the list. Workflows can use Anthropic or OpenAI, from the list or by typing a model id. OpenAI for chat is coming.

## Media library

These need a Keen server, managed or self-hosted. In a Local Workspace, Settings › Media shows a notice instead.

- **Settings › Media** lists the images and documents on your server. Open one to see where it is used, or copy it as Markdown.
- **Delete several at once.** Select the files and delete them together. Keen asks first when one is still in use.
- **Import.** Use the Import button or drop files on the list. Imported files stay until you delete them.
- **Image from library.** In the editor, type / and choose Image from library to insert an image that is already on your server. Nothing is uploaded again.
- **Images stay put.** Deleting a chat no longer removes an image you also used in a note, and an image that can't be loaded shows an "Image unavailable" card in place of a broken icon.

## Summary

- **Markdown sections show more.** They now display images and open links to files, tasks, projects, milestones and knowledge. With a Keen server, the section editor can add images and files.

## Workflows

- **Four built-in workflows.** Daily Reflection, Daily Review, Morning Focus and Unresolved Threads Tracker. Daily Reflection is your Daily Summary under a new name; its on/off switch and schedule carry over. The others start switched off. Daily Reflection and Daily Review are alternatives, so pick one.
- **See how a workflow runs.** Settings › Workflows shows each workflow's whole prompt and its steps in plain words. Change the schedule right there (Daily, Weekdays, Weekly or Manual), and Run Now tells you when a run fails.
- **Notifications you can read.** Workflow results arrive in the Inbox and in system banners as sentences, not raw data.
- **One thing to know:** Keen keeps the built-in workflows current, so an edit to a built-in's prompt is replaced the next time the server starts.

## Dates land on the right day

- **"Due tomorrow" means tomorrow.** Due dates, reminders and milestone target dates set through chat now land on the right day in your time zone.

## The assistant

- **Fewer interruptions.** Chat no longer asks "are you sure?" twice before an action you already confirmed, and a long turn now ends with an answer.
- **Task search shows open work.** Searching tasks in chat returns open, unarchived tasks unless you ask for more.

## Editor and appearance

- **A formatting bar that stays put.** On a detail page, ⌥⌘T (or ⌘K › Toggle Top Bar) swaps the toolbar that appears on selection for one fixed above the editor.
- **@ mentions in the quick-create windows.** New Project, New Knowledge and New Milestone now offer the @ menu.
- **Grayscale background.** Settings › Appearance, Custom preset: Grayscale background makes surfaces and interface text neutral while accents and note colors keep their color. In dark mode, note text stays readable at low Lightness.

## Managed hosting accounts

- **Signing in lasts.** Your sign-in to managed hosting now renews itself when Keen needs it, and Log Out… in the account menu signs that Mac out on the server too. You may be asked to sign in once after updating.
- **New accounts confirm their email.** Creating an account now asks for a 6-digit code sent to your email, and the form has a field for an invite code.

---

**Updating:** Keen updates itself — you'll be prompted on next launch, or check Settings → Updates.

**Managed servers:** this release updates the backend too. If you're on a managed server, Keen will ask you to update it after the app restarts; that takes about a minute.
